verdict.rationale: Nix clearly provides per-project environments with the right tool versions and environment variables: `nix-shell` builds or downloads dependencies and opens a shell with variables like compiler search paths set, and `nix develop` does the same for a derivation. Multiple package versions can coexist, and a hands-on user confirms `nix-shell --run` guarantees the correct dependencies. However, all of this needs an explicit command; nothing in the evidence shows automatic activation when entering a project directory (e.g., a shell hook or direnv integration). missing for 10: automatic activation on directory entry (direnv/shell-hook integration), independent corroboration of seamless auto-switching between projects
